sasha: Quick sprint pulse — kernel perf tail is up for 2nd day. Seeing P95 jump on long sequences. Owners please paste status.

sasha: Also observing KV cache cold-starts for multi-tenant bursts — evictions look aggressive.

devin: I'm on the kernel PR review. PR: <https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2104|#2104>. I left comments re: attention packing. I'll push fixes by EOD.

maria: Telemetry: latency_p95 for model-x increased from 160ms -> 280ms after yesterday's patch. Dashboard: <https://dash.rew.co/boards/latency|latency board>

jon: infra note — some pods are hitting GPU OOM on microbatches with seq_len>1024, we autoscaled but tail suffers. Reducing microbatch window helps.

priya: I'll own KV eviction heuristics tweak (PR incoming). Plan: lower eviction aggressiveness for warm caches + add a per-tenant warmup counter. Canary this afternoon.

devin: pushed a small rollback for the attention kernel variant to stabilise p95; canary build queued: `ci/canary-kernel-rollback`.

deploy-bot: deploy ci/canary-kernel-rollback started by @devin — build 4527 queued

maria: quick ask — can we get a perf deck comparing batch windows 8/16/32 for seq=512/1024? I can run synthetic across canary nodes if we agree params.

jon: yep, infra can run it. @sasha what target SLO should we gate on? p95 < 200ms?

sasha: target p95 < 220ms for canary, if we hit 200ms that's ideal. Priorities: 1) kernel rollback/cr fixes (devin) 2) KV eviction tweak (priya) 3) batch-window tuning (maria+infra)

priya: noted. I'll post PR link when ready. FYI I'll need a test tenant with steady traffic, @jon can you spin one?

jon: yes, creating tenant `canary-warmup-3` now. ETA 20m.

devin: thanks — ping me on the PR for urgent CR, also cc @sasha if CI flakes.

sasha: Backfill checklist: add telemetry tags for canary builds, add a short eval set for quality regression, and add cost delta note. I'll update the sprint board. No meeting unless folks want — prefer async updates with short pings here. :thumbsup:

maria: adding eval set now — will post results as a thread.

priya: PR: <https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2110|#2110> — initial eviction heuristic tweak. Running unit + integration.

deploy-bot: canary build 4527 started — will report within 12m

sasha: thanks all. If anyone hits an urgent blocker drop a mention here with `BLOCKER` and I'll escalate.
